title: Geometric Topology
description: Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

puzzle.goal: A compact orientable surface S with b boundary circles carries Gaussian curvature K, and its boundary curves bend within the surface with geodesic curvature κ. The total curvature integrated over the surface plus along the boundary is 2π times a topological invariant, 2 − 2g − b. Solve that for the number of handles g.
puzzle.name: Gauss–Bonnet theorem (genus from total curvature)
puzzle.ask: For a closed surface (b = 0) the total curvature equals 2π(V − E + F) for any triangulation. Find the genus of a closed surface triangulated with V = @{V}, E = @{E}, F = 24.
puzzle.method: Triangulate the surface; inside each geodesic triangle the curvature equals the angle excess. Summing over triangles turns the total into V − E + F, and each handle or hole lowers it by 2 or 1.
